advisory.finding: ImpossibleLinkStore.should_skip() calls deciding_digest() without passing self._graph_cache, so the per-pass global-structure memoisation only applies to record() (the write path) and NOT to the skip lookup (the hot, steady-state read path). A converged store with N cycle records recomputes the full-graph fingerprint (reduce_all_tickets over every ticket) once per cycle record every pass — the quadratic cost the module docstring and ticket PS2 explicitly claim to have removed.
merged_from: ImpossibleLinkStore.should_skip() recomputes the whole-graph structure fingerprint once per cycle-reason record because it calls deciding_digest() without threading self._graph_cache, producing O(k*N) work per pass (k cycle records recomputing an N-ticket reduction) — the exact quadratic the author guarded against in record() but left unguarded on the steady-state skip path.
scenarios: Steady-state pass where multiple cycle records exist: each is consulted via should_skip and each triggers a fresh reduce_all_tickets
